# Shortsmith

> Shortsmith is an open-source AI video clipper that turns long videos into captioned, vertical short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and similar platforms.

Shortsmith can be used as a hosted web application or self-hosted from its AGPL-3.0 source code. It is based on the open-source SupoClip project (https://github.com/FujiwaraChoki/supoclip). The workflow accepts YouTube URLs and uploaded video files, transcribes the source, proposes promising segments, scores candidate clips, creates face-aware vertical crops, adds word-synced captions, and exports platform-ready videos.

Links below are relative to the site that serves this file.

## Key capabilities

- AI-assisted clip discovery and candidate scoring.
- YouTube URL and uploaded-file inputs.
- Face-aware 9:16 vertical reframing.
- Word-synced animated captions and caption templates.
- Export presets for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.
- Hosted web usage or AGPL-3.0 self-hosting.
- Support for configured hosted language-model providers or Ollama.
- Transcription via AssemblyAI (default), local Whisper, or YouTube captions.
- REST API with per-user API keys, and an MCP server for AI clients.
- No watermark on exported clips.

## Important qualifications

- Virality scores prioritize candidates; they do not guarantee audience performance.
- The source code is free, but self-hosters provide their own infrastructure and any paid transcription or model-provider usage.
- A hosted deployment may require a paid plan to process videos; self-hosted installs have no plan limits.
- Users should process only videos they own or have permission to repurpose.
- Product capabilities and pricing can change; use this site and its source repository for current details.
